title: 第9章 身世成谜第10章 武爷
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
来的是毒蛇帮的人。
为首男子身上的刺青已经暴露了他自己的身份，陈凡记得昨晚在夜市上，刚收拾了几个对妹妹意图不轨的混混，领头的还被他把手打断了。
“没错，是我干的，你们也想试试？”
陈凡看着几名毒蛇帮的人，浑然不惧，挑衅地说道。
见他如此嚣张，几名毒蛇帮的小弟立刻就把刀掏了出来。
不过，为首的何猛却伸手拦住了他们。
“有胆识，现在在花城敢惹我们毒蛇帮的人已经很少了，我知道你会功夫，既然如此，敢不敢跟我走一趟？”
何猛说完不给陈凡考虑的时间，又补充道：“你总有不在家的时候，想想他们怎么办。”
说着话，何猛看向屋里一脸紧张的陈和平等人。
“我最讨厌别人用我家人威胁我。”
陈凡眯起双眼，杀气凌厉。
何猛顿时感到一阵寒意，不禁缩了缩脖子。
不过陈凡并没有在这里动手，思考片刻道：“别伤害他们，我跟你们走就是了。”
“哥，不要啊。”
“小凡不能去。”
“你们要赔多少钱，我们给就是了。”
此刻陈怡和父母也认出了毒蛇帮的人，听到陈凡要和他们走，顿时就急了。
“呵呵，别急，很快就轮到你们了。”
一名毒蛇帮的打手举着刀，冲陈怡和父母做了一个杀头的动作。
这让本就害怕的陈家人，瞬间感受到无与伦比的绝望。

他们一家好不容易才重新团聚，难道这么快就要结束了吗？
岂料下一秒，毒蛇帮打手的刀忽然消失了，等他反应过来的时候，发现刀已经到了陈凡的手上。
不光是他，其他几个亮出武器的人，手里的刀也都到了陈凡手里。
当当当——
众目睽睽之下，随着几声脆响，陈凡夺来的几把刀全都碎成了好几截，掉在地上。
“别用这些玩具吓唬我家里人，我不是已经同意跟你们走了吗？”
陈凡淡淡说道。
玩具？
嘶——
何猛倒吸一口凉气，他听受伤的小弟说陈凡可以摘叶伤人，所以刚才才忍住了没有动手。
现在看来实在太明智了。
其他毒蛇帮的人也同样被陈凡的恐怖身手震慑到了，吓得不敢再乱动。
陈凡转身对家人道：“爸，妈，小怡，你们不用担心我，我先去陪他们玩玩，等中午请洛小姐吃了饭就回来了。”
陈凡完全就没有把毒蛇帮当回事，根本不担心自己的安全，他只是记得中午说好了要请洛千凝吃饭。
不过，听他提到洛千凝，陈和平理解成了儿子要去找对方帮忙解决问题。
一想到那个神秘女子，连崔富和金宝路都要跪地求饶，他顿时心安了不少。
“好吧，那小凡你自己小心点儿，可不能怠慢了洛小姐。”
陈和平说道。
“嗯。”
陈凡点点头，跟着毒蛇帮的人离开了。

看着他们离开，陈怡和母亲范爱琴担心不已，很想报警却被陈和平制止了。
“你们难道没有听出来吗？小凡是要去找洛小姐帮忙解决问题，而且他学的功夫也挺厉害，我们应该相信他。”
陈和平说道。
“原来小凡要去找洛小姐帮忙啊，那应该不会有事的。”
范爱琴暗自祈祷。
content_en:
The people coming are from the Viper Gang.
The tattoos on the leading man's body had revealed his identity. Chen Fan remembered that at the night market last night, he had just dealt with a few gangsters who had evil intentions towards his sister, and he had broken the leader's hand.
"Yes, I did it. Do you want to try it too?"
Chen Fan looked at several members of the Viper Gang, without any fear, and said provocatively.
Seeing how arrogant he was, several members of the Viper Gang immediately took out their knives.
However, the leader, He Meng, stretched out his hand to stop them.
"You have courage. There are very few people who dare to mess with our Viper Gang in Huacheng now. I know you are good at kung fu. In this case, do you dare to come with me?"
After He Meng said that he would not give Chen Fan time to think about it, he added: "You always have to think about what they will do when you are not at home."
As he spoke, He Meng looked at Chen Heping and others who looked nervous in the room.
"I hate it when people threaten me with my family."
Chen Fan narrowed his eyes with murderous intent.
He Meng suddenly felt a chill and couldn't help but shrink his neck.
However, Chen Fan did not take action here. He thought for a moment and said, "Don't hurt them. I'll just go with you."
"Brother, no."
"Xiaofan can't go."
"We will pay you whatever compensation you want."
At this moment, Chen Yi and her parents also recognized the members of the Viper Gang. When they heard that Chen Fan was going to leave with them, they immediately became anxious.
"Haha, don't worry, it will be your turn soon."
A thug from the Viper Gang raised his knife and made a beheading gesture towards Chen Yi and his parents.
This made the already frightened Chen family instantly feel unparalleled despair.
It took a lot of effort for their family to reunite. Is it going to end so soon?
Unexpectedly, the next second, the Viper Gang thug's knife suddenly disappeared. When he reacted, he found that the knife had already reached Chen Fan's hand.
Not only him, but also the knives in the hands of several other people who showed their weapons were in Chen Fan's hands.
Dangdangdang——
In full view of everyone, with a few crisp sounds, the knives Chen Fan had snatched were all broken into several pieces and fell to the ground.
"Don't scare my family with these toys. Didn't I already agree to go with you?"
Chen Fan said calmly.
Toy?
Hiss——
He Meng took a breath. He heard from his injured brother that Chen Fan could pick leaves and hurt people, so he held back just now.
It seems so wise now.
The other members of the Viper Gang were also shocked by Chen Fan's terrifying skills, and were too frightened to move any further.
Chen Fan turned to his family and said, "Dad, Mom, Xiaoyi, you don't have to worry about me. I'll go play with them first, and I'll be back after treating Miss Luo to dinner at noon."
Chen Fan didn't take the Viper Gang seriously at all and didn't worry about his own safety at all. He just remembered that he had agreed to treat Luo Qianning to dinner at noon.
However, hearing him mention Luo Qianning, Chen Heping understood that his son was going to find him to help solve the problem.
When he thought of that mysterious woman, even Cui Fu and Jin Baolu had to kneel down and beg for mercy, he suddenly felt a lot more at ease.
"Okay, Xiaofan, please be careful and don't neglect Miss Luo."
Chen Heping said.
"Yeah."
Chen Fan nodded and left with the Viper Gang.
Watching them leave, Chen Yi and his mother Fan Aiqin were worried and wanted to call the police, but Chen Heping stopped them.
"Didn't you hear it? Xiaofan is going to find Miss Luo to help solve the problem, and he has learned a lot of skills. We should trust him."
Chen Heping said.
"It turns out that Xiaofan is going to find Miss Luo for help. He should be fine."
Fan Aiqin prayed secretly.
